Perfume.title: Perfume
Perfume.description: An Arabian fragrance listing managed by the AuraHut Co. owner with decant and full-bottle pricing and optional special promotion status.

isSampleListing.description: True if imported sample entry, false for live catalogue products

concentration.description: Fragrance concentration (e.g. Extrait de Parfum, Eau de Parfum)

image.description: Local studio image path or HTTPS product image URL

notes.description: Olfactory pyramid with top, heart, and base arrays

sizes.description: Available bottle and decant sizes (e.g. 5ml, 10ml, 22ml, 50ml, 70ml, 80ml, 100ml, or custom volumes) with SZL pricing

onSpecial.description: Whether included in the active Special / Black Friday promotions list

specialLabel.description: Optional promotional label such as Black Friday Special

specialDiscountType.description: Whether the special discount is percentage off or a fixed SZL reduction (e.g. reduce by E100)

specialDiscountPercent.description: Percentage discount (0 to 90) applied while on special

specialDiscountAmount.description: Fixed SZL price reduction (0 to 50000) applied while on special when specialDiscountType is fixed

isUnboxed.description: True if offered as an authentic unboxed / tester full bottle without retail outer box packaging

isNewArrival.description: True if highlighted in the New Arrivals showcase

availableBranches.description: Store branch IDs where this perfume is currently stocked (manzini, mbabane)

ownerUid.description: UID of the owner who created this document

Coupon.title: Coupon
Coupon.description: A promotional discount code created by the store owner for WhatsApp order pricing.

description.description: Short description of the coupon offer

discountType.description: Whether discount is percentage off or fixed SZL amount off

discountValue.description: Discount percentage (1-95) or fixed SZL amount

minOrderAmount.description: Minimum SZL subtotal required to apply coupon (0 for no minimum)

appliesTo.description: Scope of items the coupon applies to

active.description: Whether the coupon is currently active

ownerUid.description: UID of the owner who created this coupon

SpecialCampaign.title: SpecialCampaign
SpecialCampaign.description: Owner-configured promotional campaign (such as Black Friday Specials) displayed on the storefront.

badgeText.description: Short tag displayed on special items and banner

announcementText.description: Optional announcement bar message while campaign is active

promoCodeHint.description: Optional coupon code highlighted on the campaign banner

endsAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 end date/time controlling how long specials remain active

enabled.description: Whether the campaign showcase is live on the storefront

heroMode.description: Hero showcase mode: auto (specials first with new arrivals fallback), specials only, or new arrivals

newArrivalsTitle.description: Hero headline shown when the hero section displays New Arrivals

newArrivalsBadge.description: Hero eyebrow badge shown when displaying New Arrivals

newArrivalsSubtitle.description: Supporting hero subtitle shown when displaying New Arrivals

ownerUid.description: UID of the owner who configured this campaign

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Verified owner or authorized manager account record.

ComboDeal.title: ComboDeal
ComboDeal.description: A multi-perfume bundle deal with discounted bundle pricing managed by the store owner.

perfumeNames.description: List of 2 to 6 included fragrance names

sizeLabel.description: Bottle or decant sizes included (e.g. 2 × 30ml Bottles)

regularPrice.description: Original combined price in SZL before bundle discount

featured.description: Whether highlighted at the top of Combo Deals

ownerUid.description: UID of the owner who created this combo deal

LayeringIdea.title: LayeringIdea
LayeringIdea.description: A curated scent pairing guide recommending base and top fragrances with spray ratios.

occasion.description: Best time or setting for the pairing

active.description: Whether visible on the storefront Layering Ideas guide

ownerUid.description: UID of the owner who created this layering idea

WeeklyFiveMlSpecial.title: WeeklyFiveMlSpecial
WeeklyFiveMlSpecial.description: Weekly 5ml discovery decant special configuration (3 Under E500 options to choose 2 + 2 Under E800 picks) plus owner-configured Exclusive 5ml Special with custom per-scent and bundle prices.

enabled.description: Whether the Weekly 5ml Special section is active on the storefront

autoRotateWeekly.description: Whether picks automatically rotate every Monday when a new week begins

weekKey.description: ISO calendar week key (e.g. 2026-W47) associated with the saved picks

seedOffset.description: Integer seed offset for re-rolling random weekly selections

under500Ids.description: Legacy combined list of up to 3 perfume IDs selected from the Under E500 tier

under800Ids.description: Legacy combined list of up to 2 perfume IDs selected from the Under E800 tier

womenUnder500Ids.description: Up to 3 For Women perfume IDs selected from the Under E500 tier (customers choose 2)

womenUnder800Ids.description: Up to 2 For Women perfume IDs selected from the Under E800 tier

menUnder500Ids.description: Up to 3 For Men perfume IDs selected from the Under E500 tier (customers choose 2)

menUnder800Ids.description: Up to 2 For Men perfume IDs selected from the Under E800 tier

fourPackPrice.description: Bundle price in SZL for 4 × 5ml decants (default 100)

twoPackPrice.description: Bundle price in SZL for 2 × 5ml Under E500 decants (default 50)

exclusiveEnabled.description: Whether the owner-curated Exclusive 5ml Special section is live

exclusiveBadge.description: Kicker badge for the Exclusive 5ml Special

exclusiveSubtitle.description: Supporting description for the Exclusive 5ml Special

exclusiveBundleEnabled.description: Whether customers can buy all Exclusive 5ml items together at a custom bundle price

exclusiveBundlePrice.description: Custom bundle price in SZL for all Exclusive 5ml picks

exclusiveItems.description: Up to 6 owner-picked perfumes with individual custom 5ml prices

ownerUid.description: UID of the owner who configured the weekly 5ml special

GiftHamper.title: GiftHamper
GiftHamper.description: Ready-to-gift fragrance hamper / gift box curated by AuraHut Co. for gifting occasions.

occasion.description: Gifting target or occasion (e.g. For Her, For Him, Birthday, Anniversary, Corporate)

itemsIncluded.description: 1 to 8 items included inside the hamper (perfume bottles, body mist, decant, lotion, gift box)

regularPrice.description: Combined individual value in SZL before hamper pricing

image.description: Hamper photograph path or HTTPS URL

giftWrapNote.description: Packaging / presentation note (ribbon, box, greeting card)

featured.description: Whether highlighted on the Gifts & Hampers showcase

ownerUid.description: UID of the owner who created this hamper

InfluencerReferral.title: InfluencerReferral
InfluencerReferral.description: An influencer referral code and commission configuration created by the store owner.

code.description: Uppercase referral code matching document ID

socialHandle.description: TikTok, Instagram, or social media handle

commissionType.description: Whether commission is percentage of net order or fixed SZL amount per sale

commissionValue.description: Commission percentage (0-90) or flat SZL payout per sale

followerDiscountType.description: Optional discount perk given to followers who order using this referral code

followerDiscountValue.description: Follower discount value (0 if none, 1-95 if percentage, 1-50000 if fixed SZL)

payoutNote.description: Payout handle / schedule or campaign notes

active.description: Whether the referral code is currently active

partnerUid.description: Optional verified Firebase UID of the linked creator partner for scoped dashboard access

ownerUid.description: UID of the owner who created this referral profile

ReferralSale.title: ReferralSale
ReferralSale.description: An order attributed to an influencer referral code with calculated commission and payout status.

influencerName.description: Influencer display name at time of attribution

orderSummary.description: Concise item / bottle summary of the referred order

orderSubtotal.description: Fragrance subtotal in SZL before referral discount

netOrderAmount.description: Commissionable net order total in SZL

source.description: Whether logged automatically at WhatsApp checkout or manually by an admin

customerRef.description: Non-PII delivery branch/town or order reference note

partnerUid.description: Optional verified Firebase UID of the linked creator partner for scoped payout ledger access

ownerUid.description: Verified admin Firebase UID who recorded or approved this sale

PublicReferral.title: PublicReferral
PublicReferral.description: Non-sensitive public referral metadata enabling storefront code validation and follower discounts without exposing creator commission rates or payout notes.

code.description: Uppercase referral code matching document ID

socialHandle.description: TikTok, Instagram, or social media handle

followerDiscountType.description: Discount perk given to followers using this referral code

followerDiscountValue.description: Follower discount value (0 if none, 1-95 if percentage, 1-50000 if fixed SZL)

active.description: Whether the public referral code is currently active

ownerUid.description: UID of the admin who published this public projection

ReferralAttribution.title: ReferralAttribution
ReferralAttribution.description: Unprivileged storefront referral attribution captured when a customer initiates a WhatsApp checkout with an active referral code. Contains zero trusted commission fields.

influencerName.description: Display name at checkout attribution time

orderSummary.description: Summary of items quoted in the WhatsApp checkout

reportedSubtotal.description: Client-reported estimated subtotal in SZL pending staff WhatsApp verification

reportedDiscount.description: Client-reported estimated follower discount in SZL

customerRef.description: Delivery method, branch, or non-sensitive customer reference note

status.description: Review status managed by store admins ('pending' on create)

convertedSaleId.description: Authoritative /referralSales document ID once converted by admin (empty string while pending)

ownerUid.description: 'guest-checkout' for customer checkouts or verified admin UID

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Immutable administrative audit trail recording which admin username/email performed each catalogue or store configuration change and exact field-level differences.

actorEmail.description: Verified email address of the admin who performed the change

actorUsername.description: Display username of the admin who performed the change

targetLabel.description: Human-readable name or code of the affected record

summary.description: Concise human-readable description of the change

changes.description: List of up to 12 field-level change descriptions (before -> after)

ownerUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the admin actor

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of the audit event

CatalogueSnapshot.title: CatalogueSnapshot
CatalogueSnapshot.description: Compacted public catalogue payload enabling single-read storefront hydration of all perfumes while restricting writes strictly to verified admins.

totalCount.description: Total number of products encoded in itemsJson

itemsJson.description: Compact UTF-8 JSON array encoding storefront catalogue entries

ownerUid.description: Verified admin Firebase UID who generated this snapshot

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the snapshot was published

ReferralPartner.title: ReferralPartner
ReferralPartner.description: Creator / influencer referral partner onboarding and payout profile keyed strictly by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID

requestedCode.description: Preferred uppercase referral code requested during onboarding

payoutAccount.description: MoMo number, bank account reference, or branch note

ownerUid.description: Firebase UID of the partner account owner

/perfumes/{perfumeId}.description: Publicly readable Arabian fragrance catalogue curated exclusively by the owner.

/coupons/{couponId}.description: Coupon discount codes. Only active codes can be fetched individually by exact ID at checkout; inactive codes, listing, and CRUD are restricted to the owner.

/campaigns/{campaignId}.description: Storefront special event settings such as Black Friday Specials.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Authorized admin records managed strictly by the bootstrapped owner.

/combos/{comboId}.description: Multi-perfume bundle deals readable publicly when active and managed by the store owner.

/layeringIdeas/{ideaId}.description: Curated perfume layering pairings readable publicly when active and managed by the store owner.

/weeklySpecials/{specialId}.description: Publicly readable Weekly 5ml Special configuration managed strictly by the store owner.

/hampers/{hamperId}.description: Ready-to-gift hampers readable publicly when active and managed strictly by the store owner.

/referrals/{referralId}.description: Influencer referral codes, commission rates, and payout notes managed by store admins and readable individually by the linked partnerUid.

/publicReferrals/{referralId}.description: Public active-only referral projection used at checkout to apply follower discounts without exposing creator commission rates.

/referralAttributions/{attributionId}.description: Write-once checkout referral attributions submitted by shoppers for admin review prior to creating verified commission records.

/referralSales/{saleId}.description: Authoritative commission ledger written strictly by store admins and readable only by admins or the linked partnerUid.

/referralPartners/{partnerId}.description: Partner creator onboarding applications and payout preferences keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable admin activity and change history ledger readable and appendable strictly by verified store admins.

/catalogueSnapshots/{snapshotId}.description: Single-document compacted public catalogue cache (`public`) readable by shoppers in one Firestore read and maintained strictly by verified admins.
